purpose: Keywords `now_filters.hidden_rival` (Python, engine-api / rails) and `engine/apps/web/src/lib/hiddenRival.ts` (TypeScript, the web app's own fallback) must BOTH drop from `engine/packages/taxonomy/seed/terms/type.json`'s subtype label/alias vocabulary when building the guard's NAME-matching pattern. This is the second half of the guard's 'one source of truth': the lexicon itself is `type.json` (shared with the E2.1 classifier prompt, unmodified); this file is the guard-specific curation on top of it, so both languages exclude the exact same words for the exact same measured reason, without either one hand-rolling its own denylist.

drink.reason: Measured against real place_mentions/places in both cities (~250 hand-reviewed `role='featured'` rows, ticket report has the full count): the bare word 'club' -- correct as `nightclub`'s own taxonomy alias, used by the E2.1 classifier prompt -- was the dominant false-positive source for `drink` as a NAME-match keyword. Golf clubs, private members' clubs, expat business/social associations ('The American Club Jakarta', 'Royale Jakarta Golf Club', 'Women's International Club', 'Club Med') outnumbered genuine drink venues roughly 3 to 1 in the sample. Every genuine true positive in the sample ('Potato Head Beach Club', 'Sundays Beach Club', 'BUNK Lobby Lounge', 'Emilia Bar Italiano') still matches via a more specific surviving phrase ('beach club', 'lounge', 'bar'), so this trades a small, measured recall loss (5 Bali articles caught ONLY via bare 'club': 'Mama San Supper Club', 'Kuta Social Club' x2, 'The Jungle Club Ubud', 'KANVA Ubud by K Club') for removing the majority of false positives -- the right side to err on for a guard whose failure mode must be 'misses a rival', not 'wrongly empties a rail'.

stay.reason: Second-pass review (2026-09-24): a candidate whose OWN title names a subtype label/alias of a type the subject excludes, checked ONLY when that candidate's own primary_type is non-venue (exclude_same=false: event/editorial/do) or NULL -- venue-typed candidates are untouched by this signal, unchanged from the first pass. Hand-reviewed ~440 real title matches across both cities (drink/eat/shop/stay/wellness): `stay` measured ~85.5% precision on Bali (59/69), ~94% on Jakarta (~110/117) -- driven by specific hotel/resort BRAND NAMES in promotional titles ('The Westin Resort Nusa Dua, Bali Presents...', 'Hard Rock Hotel Bali', 'Sofitel Bali Nusa Dua Beach Resort'), which is exactly what catches article 4417 on a `stay` subject's page. `drink` measured borderline (~84% combined, small/noisy Jakarta sample dominated by the idiom 'walk into a bar' and the brand coincidence 'Pilates Re Bar') and is NOT enabled here pending a bare-'bar' curation, same shape as the `club` fix above.

not_yet_enabled.eat: 37.5% Bali / 71% Jakarta (combined ~53%, n=30) -- dominated by this magazine's OWN recurring 'NOW! Best Restaurant, Bar and Cafe Awards' franchise and industry-association pieces ('Bali Restaurant & Cafe Association'), which legitimately contain 'restaurant'/'cafe' without naming a competing venue. Proposed override: a negative-phrase exclusion (title also matching 'award|awards|association|industry') rather than removing 'restaurant'/'cafe' themselves, which are otherwise precise words.
not_yet_enabled.shop: 45% Bali / ~46% Jakarta -- dominated by generic single words ('market' in a business/finance sense, 'craft'/'artisan'/'batik' in cultural-history pieces, 'library' in unrelated topic pieces, 'plaza' as part of an unrelated hotel brand name e.g. 'Crowne Plaza'). Proposed override: drop the single generic words ('craft', 'artisan', 'batik', 'library', 'market') from the TITLE-matching lexicon specifically (keep them for the featured-mention signal, where a PROPER-NOUN place name carries much less of this risk) and require a multi-word phrase ('shopping mall', 'night market', 'concept store') instead.
not_yet_enabled.wellness: 51% Bali / similar Jakarta -- dominated by 'beauty' used as an abstract noun in travel/culture writing ('Tasmania: A Journey Through Untamed Beauty') and generic 'yoga'/'spa'/'retreat'/'meditation' with no venue named. Proposed override: same shape as `shop` -- drop single generic words from the title lexicon, require a brand-adjacent phrase.
